caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, long-sleeved gown with a fitted bodice and wide, flowing skirt, shown on a plain, off-white or light beige background. The dress is primarily an off-white or very light cream color with a slightly blue or grayish tone and is decorated with vertical stripes and intricate floral embroidery. The embroidery features garlands and sprays of flowers in shades of pink, yellow, green, and brown, distributed along the front edges, across the skirt, and on the sleeves. The gown includes a square neckline with decorative trim, and the sleeves are adorned with ruffles and bands near the elbows. The garment is open at the front to reveal an underlayer or petticoat featuring horizontal stripes in neutral tones, occasionally bordered with small blue decorative lines. The edges of the gown are finished with a yellow trim, providing further embellishment to the design. No human figure is present in the drawing; only the dress is shown.
title: Dress
